절개 부위 주변의 표면 변형을 관찰하고, 피부 인장 반응을 별도로 모델링: I observed surface deformation near incisions and identified the need to model skin tension separately.

기존 제약 그룹핑 및 투영 구조에 STC를 결합하고, 적용 전후의 절개: I integrated STC into the existing constraint grouping and projection pipeline and compared incision shapes and parallel resampling times with and without STC.

CT의 HU 값을 AlphaTable 전달 함수로 바꿉니다. −449 H: CT HU values are converted using the AlphaTable transfer function. Below −449 HU is air (α = 0); opacity increases linearly from −449 to 6 HU and is fully opaque above 6 HU.
각 정점의 α가 0이면 공기, 0보다 크면 피부로 봅니다. 임곗값은 데이: A vertex with α = 0 is air; one with α greater than zero is treated as skin. Thresholds can be adjusted to the dataset.
네 정점 중 공기 정점 수를 셉니다. 정확히 1개일 때만 나머지 세 정점: Count air vertices among the four vertices. Form a triangle from the other three only when exactly one is air.

공기 정점이 없으면 내부 조직, 둘 이상이면 경계가 불명확한 영역이라 제: Tetrahedra with no air vertices are internal tissue; those with two or more have ambiguous boundaries and are excluded. Only the outer surface is activated, avoiding tension on internal structures and limiting the number of constraints to surface triangles.
면적이 기준보다 커질 때만 복원 계수를 키워, 늘어난 피부가 원래 크기로: The restoring coefficient increases only when the current area exceeds the rest area, approximating stretched skin returning to its original size. Corrections are distributed among the three vertices according to inverse mass and area gradients.
병렬 리샘플링 시간, STC 미적용 대비 적용: Parallel resampling time, without vs. with STC
세 해상도의 데이터셋(A, B, C)에서 STC 적용 여부에 따른 전처리: Preprocessing grouping and PBD parallel resampling times were compared across three dataset resolutions (A, B, C). Each frame used five constraint projection iterations in distance-constraint then STC order, with each stage parallelized using CUDA. Resampling time is the mean of ten consecutive frames on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090.
STC를 추가해도 세 데이터 모두에서 그룹핑 시간과 커널 단위 병렬 처리: Adding STC produced little difference in grouping time and kernel-level parallel processing performance across the three datasets. STC is an independent triangle-level constraint that integrates without conflict into existing parallel groups, and is applied only at the skin boundary, with fewer than 10% as many elements as the volume-wide distance and volume constraints.
